notes.title: EXODIUM Part 1 — new demo version
notes.content: [p]The new [b]EXODIUM[/b] demo opens the beginning of Chapter Two. This time, together with special forces captain Melissa Novak, you must pass through the dark corridors of the Security Complex — once guarded by soldiers… until they became infected and enslaved by another will.[/p][h3]In this demo you will find:[/h3][list][*][p]The first steps of Melissa’s storyline, where exploration gradually turns into a deadly confrontation.[/p][/*][*][p]Encounters with former defenders who now resemble nightmares from a biological report more than soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p]An atmosphere of silence, interrupted by sudden bursts of action.[/p][/*][*][p]New environmental details and refinements based on your feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p]In the demo you can discover journals revealing the first details of what happened in the Complex, face enemies who were once human, and experience the tension of survival in a closed environment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774763/80ca0cdf395c9c5ceddff4b29d394fd892858c39.png"][/img][/p]
